_about: Rules for the Vodafone Idea paper trader. Paper trading only: no orders are ever sent. Approved by the owner on 23 Nov 2026.
_start_date_note: First trading day the bot trades (India time).
_equity_key_note: Upstox key for Vodafone Idea shares (ISIN INE669E01016). Candles come from Upstox's public 1-minute API, no login.
_capital_note: Each plan starts with Rs 5 lakh and keeps its own account. Profits and losses compound into the next trade.
_overnight_entry_note: Plan A buys the VI future at the volume-weighted average price of these 1-minute candles (how NSE sets the closing price), plus slip_paise.
_overnight_exit_note: Plan A sells at the opening price of this minute = the pre-open auction price. No spread is charged in the auction.
_roll_note: Hold the nearest expiry until fewer than this many trading days are left after today, then use the next month (both are in the futures pre-open auction).
_fut_margin_note: Upstox margin for one VI futures lot on 23 Nov 2026 = 43% of its value (includes VI's extra 15% exposure margin).
_lot_cushion_note: Extra cash kept per lot, as a share of the lot's value (Rs 1.2 lakh on today's lot = the worst run of losses in the backtest). Lots = what the account can carry with this cushion; at least 1 lot if the account covers the margin.
_gap_threshold_note: Plan B shorts only if VI's auction open is at least this % above yesterday's last price.
_short_minutes_note: Short at the 09:15 opening (auction) price, buy back at the opening price of the 09:16 minute plus slip_paise.
_short_leverage_note: Upstox intraday margin for VI is 19.6%, so the short is 5 x the account.
_short_cap_note: Largest short, Rs 50 lakh: about 6% of what VI trades in the 09:16 minute on gap-up days, so our own order would not move the price much.
_slip_note: Half of VI's usual 1-paisa bid-ask spread, paid on every fill outside the auction.
_charges_note: Per order: Rs 20 brokerage, STT on the sell side, exchange fee, stamp duty on the buy side, SEBI fee, 18% GST on brokerage + exchange fee.

backtest_reference._note: What the research expects (Nov 2025 - Nov 2026 replay on today's terms). The paper test checks whether this still holds.
